text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The authorities put a price on the heads of armed groups. They offered rewards between 1.0 million and 4.5 million dinars for information leading to the capture of leaders of armed groups.
- The Transitional National Council to vote party law on Tuesday.
- Thirty-three people massacred in Kerrach village, near Blida, on Sunday-Monday night.
- The Transitional National Council debates privatisation law.
- President Liamine Zeroual succeeded in forging a consensus on his plan to hold parliamentary election in the first half of 1997.
